info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Facility Site Administrations-spec
info.description: The Facility Site Administration Listing API provides access to details about the administration of various facility sites. This endpoint enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of site administrations, which is crucial for facility management and operational oversight. Typical consumers include facility managers and banking operations teams who need to monitor and manage site-specific administrative tasks. By using this API, organizations can enhance their administrative workflows and ensure effective governance of their facilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about site administration, helping you manage and understand site-specific settings and configurations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve site administration details for facilities. The expected content type is application/json, and it must adhere to the defined schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

ListFacilitySiteAdministrationsRequest.title: Site Administration Operations GET Request Body

items.description: A list of operation items related to site administration.

sort.description: Indicates the sorting order of the items.
